scope: Verifier design uses train/validation requests and contracts only; reference fixture checks may cover all authored templates. No revised model inference or held-out inference has begun.

probes.boundary_records: For public date windows insert completed records immediately before start and at exclusive end; require output invariance. For ungrouped net-count with public monetary threshold insert one below and one at threshold; expect count +1.
probes.cancelled_null_discount: For excludes_cancelled contracts insert cancelled rows with NULL discount; require invariance.
probes.discount_irrelevance: Only if human-authored discount_irrelevant is true, change non-NULL discount values while preserving missingness; require invariance.

family_partition: study/mutation_family_split.json; existing allocation retained. Evaluation families are retrospective, not a fresh unseen holdout.
